key_insight: OptGraph improves automated optimization by converting past problem-solving experience into a typed graph and retrieving neighborhood knowledge to support better modeling, verification, and refinement.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical no-finetuning workflow for reusing solver knowledge across diverse computational tasks, which can reduce iteration cost and improve robustness in automated engineering optimization pipelines.
method: Build a typed graph of reusable experience linking modeling patterns, formalization, implementation details, and error corrections.
At inference, retrieve graph neighborhoods to add structured context for problem solving and iterative refinement.
Continuously update the graph from execution traces and verification feedback without LLM parameter tuning.
evidence_signal: On benchmark datasets, OptGraph reports an average exact accuracy improvement of 8.9% over the strongest prompt-based automated optimization baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of graph construction and retrieval; noisy or incomplete graph updates could weaken the benefits of GraphRAG.
paper_title: OptGraph: Large Language Models Enhanced Evolutionary Optimization Via Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
